description:
Our brand
At City Bath Society, we are passionate about bringing the joy of relaxation to everyone, no matter their space or lifestyle. As a Melbourne-based business, we specialise in high-quality inflatable baths designed to provide ultimate comfort and relaxation. Our products are carefully selected and crafted to bring a luxurious bathing experience to those who may not have access to a traditional bathtub, whether they're limited by space, budget, or mobility.

Our mission is to make a bathing experience accessible to all, and we aim to provide the best customer service and satisfaction. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or share a moment of tranquillity with a loved one, we believe everyone deserves the perfect bath experience.

Product Description

Our City Bath inflatable bathtub is a game-changer for those who want the comfort of a bath without the need for a permanent fixture. Made from durable, high-quality PVC, the bath is designed to be inflated and deflated with ease, making it perfect for homes with limited space or renters. It features a comfortable base that feels like a thick yoga mat, providing better comfort than a traditional cold, hard bathtub.

Use

The bath is easy to set up, and each one comes with an electric pump for quick inflation and deflation, plus a drainage hose for hassle-free water removal. Whether for personal use or as a gift, it's the ideal solution for anyone craving a relaxing soak.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

Convenience & Portability: Unlike traditional bathtubs, our inflatable bath is easy to set up and can be deflated and stored when not in use. Ideal for small homes, apartments, or even camping trips, it offers a relaxing bath experience without taking up permanent space.

Comfort & Support: The thick base feels like a yoga mat, offering far more comfort than a traditional hard bathtub. It's perfect for those who want to soak in comfort after a long day.

Quick Setup & Use: The included electric pump makes inflating and deflating the bath a breeze, no heavy lifting, no hassle. Perfect for people who value ease of use and convenience.

Great Gift Idea: Offering both practical use and aesthetic appeal, it's an ideal gift for loved ones.
